en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2825 - Abdullah ibn Sinan asked Abu Abdullah (as)
about a man who arrives for Hajj and finds the heat unbearable, so he performs Tawaf around the Ka'bah but delays the Sa’y until it cools down.
Abu Abdullah (as) replied: "There is no harm in doing so, and I have sometimes done it myself."
